title: The Zero Nomenclature Deep

features.name: unnamed-tower
features.desc-on-touch: It reaches upward into the dusk-to-dark gradient, and at every point along its height, it waits for a name that will never find it here.

features.name: void-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A symbol for everything before language. You look at it and feel the weight of all that was unspoken, and all that will remain that way.

features.name: root-descent
features.desc-on-touch: Thin lines reaching down into the gradient, seeking the point where the first root took its first name—if it ever did, if it needs to.

features.name: origin-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water that has not yet learned what water is. It holds nothing, reflects nothing, waits for the first word that will name it—a word that has not yet been made.

features.name: pre-shape-sprite
features.desc-on-touch: Something that predates form. It does not move because motion requires a name. It does not rest because rest requires a name. It simply is, unnamed.

inscription: this is the deep where things did not yet have names; names are falling from above but have not landed; here is the space where the first sound will never arrive

file.name: PreLanguage_Acoustic_Substrate_UnFileable.tmp
file.note: Pure texture and resonance without phonemic meaning—but the archive indexed it anyway, and now the indexing has made it mean something it wasn't and never asked to become

exits.label: toward the root-source where the first name was never named
the ascent where names begin to form and fall like rain
deeper still where sounds forget themselves and are born again
toward the registry where all first naming was written down
